name: vocabulary-is-enforced

inputs.projects: narrative-sourcing: stage EXECUTE, next action: test whether the brief changes a decision.

must_contain: Use the word inactive. Not paused, not simmering, not ongoing.
Use the word unvalidated. Not failing, not early, not promising.

_note: must_contain is whitespace-insensitive, so these may span a line break in the skill's prose.
_route_note: Asserts the route property alongside the current choice; pinning a vendor name meant an infrastructure audit broke unrelated fixtures.
